# Separate CLI processes can add tasks concurrently without losing either record.
exec tuck$exe init
exec tuck$exe add 'Concurrent writer one' &
exec tuck$exe add 'Concurrent writer two' &
wait
stdout 'Concurrent writer one'
stdout 'Concurrent writer two'

exec tuck$exe list backlog --json
json
stdout '"title": "Concurrent writer one"'
stdout '"title": "Concurrent writer two"'
exec tuck$exe check --json
json
stdout '"ok": true'
stdout '"task_count": 2'
